notes: MG1655 in LB at 37 C or 45 C, early log or stationary. Conflicting phase evidence for the early-log samples: titles say early logarithmic, but the treatment protocol (written for the 3C libraries) samples at OD600 2 before and 10 min / 2.5 h after the shift to 45 C; growth_phase left out for early-log samples, stationary kept as stated. 45 C samples labelled heat (characteristics say 'untreated' for all, read as no chemical treatment); exposure left out because the protocol describes both growth at 45 C and a shift at OD 2. All 37 C samples are controls. WT re-read: Unmodified MG1655 WT -> wild_type.
